Definition: to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow
BiblicalUsage: 1) to press upon, oppress, violate, defraud, do violence, get deceitfully, wrong, extort; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to oppress, wrong, extort; 1a2) to oppress; 1b) (Pual) to be exploited, be crushed
